scope: Same 64 previous inputs and labels, development replay; no new blind data, no axes or model selection.
interpretation_limits: Fixed native z window 0..60 voxels and direction use known old layout as development prior; not orientation-invariant or a blind test.
Whole native 3D cells are grouped before training. Block offsets 2..7 are retained; offsets 0,1,8,9 are guards. Outside cells are explicitly excluded.
Each fold independently estimates origin/PCA, training axial 5-95% quantiles and maximum radius from training voxel centers only. Both representations share that fold frame.
Raw training weights use only training occupied-cell counts. Heldout weights use only heldout counts and affect scores only.
Shared source inputs, voxel size, external grid, model forms and numerical settings remain common; folds and repeated conditions are correlated.
Old and new scores evaluate different point subsets and representations of training geometry: paired development comparison is not a causal one-variable ablation.
Model flexibility, circle overlap, open surfaces, active bounds and optimizer failures preclude physical selection; missing points are not measured free space.

engineering_revision.reason: One v1 test read an ignored local input manifest. r1 generates its fixture from tracked protocol; model, split and numerical settings unchanged.
